environment.description: Dashboard preview service deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with default configuration. No additional response header manipulation. Service runs on port 8080 with direct ALB target group routing. The ALB performs health checks on /summary endpoint. No CloudFront distribution or edge functions in the request path. Security groups allow inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to ALB and ALB-to-task on 8080.

config.network: Public ALB, private subnets for tasks
